main_text.p: Wan eis aber eine Iunge nimyth [?]
Mit sanfter yost ins prodis [illegible, ~5 letters]
Vnd d feller gesares, mit gusserm sen [?] [illegible, ~4 letters]
Si gen seter setes, est si libr conneda [?]
Alla sete sete, wie at alla sete wiede [illegible, ~4 letters]

page.notes: Handwritten German in cursive (Kurrent). The hand is difficult, and many words are doubtful, so almost every line carries [?] or an illegible marker. The readings are best guesses, not checked letter by letter, and should be verified against the scan. There is a small mark at the top edge that may be a foliation or a stray stroke; I have left it out. The page contains no page number, running head, catchword or signature.
